name: The Luminous Sounding
image_style: A 16:10 landscape wallpaper rendered as a hand-built shadow-puppet diorama photographed on blackened linen: layered cut vellum, translucent mica, etched brass foil, tiny wool fibers, and theatrical backlighting create crisp silhouettes with delicate material texture. The mood is maritime, archival, uncanny, and quietly comic—an old navigational world made tactile and dimensional, interrupted by Space Ghost’s unwavering professional seriousness. Use a rare palette of abyssal ink-blue, brackish jade, smoked peach, chalk-mica white, and minute flashes of signal red; preserve deep transparent shadows and luminous edge-light rather than painterly brushwork. Set the scene in a submerged Roman harbor research chamber, with vaulted stone ruins, suspended diving bells, coral-encrusted instruments, ropes, and a calm dark water column. Space Ghost stands on a lower-right inspection gantry, recognizable in a muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, carefully taking measurements from a tiny ancient amphora with an enormous brass caliper while divers continue their dignified archaeological work. His cape floats slightly in the water as if this were entirely normal. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, frame, or border. Keep the upper third broad, quiet, and low-detail for a desktop panel, with a calm shadowed lower-left region for widgets.
scene: A striking 16:10 landscape inside a submerged Roman harbor archaeology chamber at blue-black twilight: intact stone arches and fallen columns recede through clear water, suspended diving bells glow faintly, coral and silt soften the ancient masonry, and an illuminated worktable holds brushes, calipers, pottery fragments, and labeled-but-unreadable excavation tags. In the lower-right, Space Ghost—muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands—stands on a narrow inspection gantry, solemnly measuring a tiny amphora with an absurdly oversized brass caliper while two historically dressed divers continue their careful excavation nearby. His cape drifts underwater, the only overtly impossible detail. The composition leaves a broad nearly empty upper water column and a calm dark lower-left area for widgets; no text, lettering, sacred imagery, worship, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
